statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk 3% (low) with no Nasdaq-100 price path observable during the CME weekend halt, against Stress of 78% (high).
recommendation: Tail remains far below the block threshold, so the mapped policy state stays EA_ON. A narrow danger window is published across the 22:00Z CME reopen and the two hours after it (00:00-03:00 Berlin on 5 October), where the forecast Tail path reaches the WATCH band on gap and discontinuity risk rather than on observed structure.
headline: Nasdaq-100 carries a record close through the weekend futures halt while an unconfirmed Aramco fire and a tightening Red Sea blockade keep Stress high and Tail at its floor
body:
CME equity-index futures have been halted since Friday 21:00Z and reopen at 22:00Z on 4 October, so no Nasdaq-100 price path exists to assess and Tail stays at its structural floor. The last observed path was orderly two-way behaviour: the index traded to an all-time intraday high of 31,017.53 on Friday 2 October, fully retraced it, and finished at a record 30,807.93 close in the lower part of the session range, up 1.00%, with VIX settling at 15.31, down 6.59%. A record high that is fully retraced into the close is the opposite of the shallow-pullback, repeated-extension structure that Tail measures.

Stress is high rather than low because the backdrop behind that record close is unusually tense. Brent is around 102 dollars after a roughly 7% monthly gain, and the Federal Reserve H.15 release dated 2 October shows the 2-year at 4.78%, the 10-year at 5.24% and the 30-year at 5.61%. Elevated crude and a 5.24% long-end yield are the two forces that framed the entire week, and neither resolves over a weekend.

The Saudi-Houthi conflict escalated further over the weekend, and the distinction between claim and confirmation matters here. Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said the group struck an Aramco facility in Riyadh with ballistic missiles and drones; witnesses and news agencies reported flames and black smoke at the site. Saudi-led coalition spokesman Turki al-Maliki called the Houthi account misleading, and neither Saudi authorities nor Aramco have confirmed the cause of the fire, any damage, or any impact on production, refining or exports. Yemeni government forces reported 97 targeting operations against Houthi positions in Taiz and Lahij. The durable oil driver remains the Red Sea chokepoint rather than this single unconfirmed fire: Houthi forces hold the Yemeni Red Sea coastline including Mocha, Dhubab and Perim Island, and have declared a blockade on Saudi vessels, which is what carried Brent above 100 dollars.

Index leadership on the last observed session sat in semiconductors and high-beta growth following Micron's record fiscal 2026, reported at fiscal Q4 non-GAAP earnings of 33.42 dollars per share on revenue up 379%, with management describing memory supply as tighter into fiscal 2027 and 2028. Earnings-driven strength of that kind informs Stress and Confidence rather than Tail.

The forecast therefore holds Tail at its floor through the closed Sunday hours and raises it into the WATCH band only across the 22:00Z reopen and the two hours after it, where the risk is a gap, which is a discontinuity in price rather than a persistent trend. That elevation is conditional on an unknown gap, not on observed structure, and a contained reopen would retire it quickly. The published decay afterwards assumes orderly two-way discovery; a gap that holds without meaningful retracement, or a second leg after a failed retracement, would invalidate that assumption. The shared deterministic context file was stale and only partially collected at assessment time, so it contributed no current evidence and this assessment rests entirely on independently verified sources.

lookbackSummary: Across the past 24 hours Claude published Tail between 6% and 3%, reaching a 3% floor from 12:00Z on 3 October and holding it through the weekend halt, while Stress bottomed at 52% in the European afternoon and then rebuilt steadily to 77% by 07:00Z on 4 October. Confidence stayed in the 83-88% band. Every hour mapped to EA_ON and green, and the dominant mode was normal throughout.
outlookSummary: The closed Sunday session carries no scoreable Nasdaq-100 structure, so Tail is held at 3-6% through 20:00Z while Stress sits at a 79% ceiling as unpriced weekend headline flow accumulates. Tail then steps to 12% in the final closed hour and is raised to 21-23%, inside the WATCH band, across the 22:00Z CME reopen and the two hours after it, which form the published danger window. It decays conditionally to 10% by 07:00Z on 5 October on the assumption that price discovery is orderly, an assumption that a gap holding without meaningful retracement would invalidate. Confidence troughs at 79% in the final closed hour and recovers to 85% once a continuous path is observable again.
